scene: You step from the slow lift into the bustling, tiled Chess Pavilion.
picture: Flat side view. Along one level checkered floor, an ornate open brass lift sits far left. An elderly East Asian man in a blue cap, orange cardigan, and holding a cane stands left. In the centre, a seated brass automaton faces a giant chessboard. On the right, a round tea table holds a steaming teapot.
shown: an ornate brass cage lift with open mesh doors on the far left
a wind-up brass automaton sitting behind an oversized chessboard in the centre
a steaming ceramic teapot placed on a round garden table on the right

variants.scene: Gentle lantern light glows across the tiled pavilion as chess pieces click together softly.
You lean on your cane, still wondering about {quest} in this grand gaming hall.
Fragrant steam drifts past grand glass arches where thinkers ponder their next moves.
